scope: Independent published switching constraint for I8282 output-driver candidates; not specimen calibration

switchingLoad.topology: Output to 2.01-V source through 78 ohms; 300 pF from output to ground

excluded: The separate 33-ohm and 180-ohm loads concern tri-state tests. The 1.5-V reference concerns propagation delay, not the explicitly specified rise/fall thresholds. No output capacitance is inferred from input CIN.
